extracted.intended_audience: VA communications staff, media relations officers, intergovernmental partners, journalists, and the public
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and responsibilities for coordinating VA external public affairs communications and intergovernmental engagement, including media relations, multi-channel dissemination, strategic advice to leadership, and ceremonial program selection (Veterans Day poster).

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordinate and orchestrate release of external public affairs communication
rubrics_metrics.description: Public Affairs is responsible for coordinating and orchestrating the release of external public affairs communication and information for VA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coordinate with VA’s three Administrations — Veterans Benefits Administration (VBA), Veterans Health Administration (VHA) and National Cemetery Administration (NCA) — and other offices throughout VA to manage external communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure accurate and timely information to Veterans, families, beneficiaries and stakeholders
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure Veterans and their families, other beneficiaries and stakeholders receive accurate and timely information about Department benefits and programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Communications should prioritize accuracy and timeliness about benefits, programs, and other topics relevant to Veterans and stakeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use all forms of traditional and new media to communicate
rubrics_metrics.description: Using all forms of traditional and new media to communicate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Employ multiple channels (traditional media, digital/social/new media) to reach diverse audiences and maximize message penetration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide VA leadership with strategic advice, guidance, and information
rubrics_metrics.description: We also provide VA leadership with strategic advice, guidance, and information by fostering partnerships and liaising between state, local, tribal, insular, and international governments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support leadership decision-making through strategic communications counsel, partnership-building, and cross-jurisdictional liaison work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Act as liaison and manage intergovernmental collaboration
rubrics_metrics.description: Intergovernmental Affairs is responsible for all relations between VA and international, state, county, municipal and tribal governments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Primary function is to provide strategic advice, guidance and information about VA to foster and enhance government partnerships; act as liaison between VA and the White House to further state and local policy; manage collaboration with federal, state, county, municipal, tribal, insular and international governments and faith-based leaders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Build confidence in VA and demonstrate readiness to serve Veterans
rubrics_metrics.description: OPIA works to build confidence in VA and its readiness to serve America’s Veterans of all generations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frame messaging to foster public trust and to emphasize VA's capability and readiness to serve Veterans across generations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Veterans Day poster selection and distribution process
rubrics_metrics.description: The Committee selects a poster from artwork submitted by artists nationwide.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selected poster is distributed to VA facilities, military installations around the world, and across cities and towns; the poster serves as the cover of the official program for the Veterans Day Observance at Arlington National Cemetery.
